question.text: Which document operationalises the DELEGATION of management powers from the Trustee of an AIF to the Investment Manager?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 8.5: once the trust is settled, the Trustee enters into an Investment Management Agreement with the Manager to delegate management and administration of the AIF. The IMA is the operative document for this delegation. The Trap: Option A (Trust Deed) creates the trust itself. Option B (PPM) is the offer document to investors. Option D (Contribution Agreement) governs the investor's commitment. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B refer to PPM prominently. XIX-C tests document-hierarchy — Trust Deed vs IMA vs PPM vs Contribution Agreement. Manager's Pro-Tip: Negotiate your IMA carefully — termination clauses, key-man provisions and fee economics live here, not in the PPM. LPs rarely see the IMA, so its content reflects the trustee-manager bargain alone.
